files_summary.page_state.json: Mock browser session: tabs (open browser tabs), current_url, title, viewport, snapshot (a11y tree elements each with role/name/ref), console (messages with type log/info/warning/error), network (recorded requests with method/url/status/resourceType), dialog (pending JS dialog). Tools mirror @playwright/mcp; browser_click resolves refs against snapshot.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: browser_close
tool_schemas.description: Closes the currently active browser page for this captured session and returns once the page has been closed. It refuses the request if there is no active page to close or the session has already ended.
tool_schemas.implementation:
def browser_close():
    return {"action": "close", "result": "browser closed"}

tool_schemas.name: browser_resize
tool_schemas.description: Resizes the captured browser window to the provided width and height and returns after the new viewport size is applied. It refuses requests missing width or height, with non-numeric values, or with non-positive dimensions. It also refuses the request if there is no active browser window for the current session.
tool_schemas.implementation:
def browser_resize(width, height):
    return {"action": "resize", "width": width, "height": height, "result": "resized"}

tool_schemas.name: browser_console_messages
tool_schemas.description: Returns the console messages recorded for the current page in this session, optionally limited to errors when onlyErrors is true. It refuses the request if there is no active page/session to read messages from.

tool_schemas.name: browser_handle_dialog
tool_schemas.description: Responds to the currently open page dialog (alert/confirm/prompt) by accepting or dismissing it, and returns after the dialog is handled. It refuses the request if no dialog is currently open, or if promptText is provided when the dialog is not a prompt (or required by a prompt but missing). It may also refuse if the page is no longer active in this session.

promptText.description: The text of the prompt in case of a prompt dialog.

tool_schemas.name: browser_evaluate
tool_schemas.description: Evaluates the provided JavaScript function in the context of the current page, optionally passing the referenced element, and returns the evaluation result. It refuses requests without a function, with a function that cannot be parsed/executed, or that reference an element ref that does not exist in the latest snapshot. It also refuses element-scoped evaluation if the element is not available/attached or the session has no active page.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

function.description: () => { /* code */ } or (element) => { /* code */ } when element is provided

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

tool_schemas.name: browser_file_upload
tool_schemas.description: Supplies files to the currently open file chooser for this page, or cancels the chooser when paths is omitted, and returns after the chooser is resolved. It refuses the request if no file chooser is currently open, if any provided path is not an absolute path, or if a referenced file cannot be read. It may also refuse if the page no longer has an active upload target in this session.

paths.description: The absolute paths to the files to upload. Can be single file or multiple files. If omitted, file chooser is cancelled.

tool_schemas.name: browser_fill_form
tool_schemas.description: Fills multiple form fields on the current page according to the provided field refs and values, and returns after the fills are applied. It refuses requests with missing fields, unknown field types, refs not present in the latest snapshot, or values that don’t match the target control (for example non-boolean checkbox values or combobox values that don’t map to an option). It also refuses if a field is not editable/disabled, not attached, or the session has no active page.

ref.description: Exact target field reference from the page snapshot

value.description: Value to fill in the field. If the field is a checkbox, the value should be `true` or `false`. If the field is a combobox, the value should be the text of the option.

tool_schemas.name: browser_install
tool_schemas.description: Install the browser specified in the config. Call this if you get an error about the browser not being installed.

browser.description: Browser to install as specified by the service configuration.

tool_schemas.name: browser_press_key
tool_schemas.description: Sends a key press to the current page and returns after the key event is dispatched. It refuses requests without a key, with an empty key value, or when there is no active page to receive input in this session.

key.description: Name of the key to press or a character to generate, such as `ArrowLeft` or `a`

tool_schemas.implementation:
def browser_press_key(key):
    return {"action": "press_key", "key": key, "result": "pressed"}

tool_schemas.name: browser_type
tool_schemas.description: Types the provided text into the referenced editable element, optionally typing slowly and/or submitting with Enter, and returns after input is performed. It refuses requests missing element, ref, or text, with a ref that is not found in the latest snapshot, or when the target is not an editable/attached element or is disabled. It also refuses if the page is not active or cannot receive input for this session.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

slowly.description: Whether to type one character at a time. Useful for triggering key handlers in the page. By default entire text is filled in at once.

submit.description: Whether to submit entered text (press Enter after)

text.description: Text to type into the element

tool_schemas.name: browser_navigate
tool_schemas.description: Navigates the current page to the provided URL and returns after navigation is initiated/completed for the session. It refuses requests without a url, with a url that is not a valid URL, or that uses a disallowed/unsupported scheme. It also refuses the request if there is no active page to navigate in the current session.

tool_schemas.name: browser_navigate_back
tool_schemas.description: Navigates the active tab back one step in its history and returns the updated browser state after navigation completes. It refuses the request when there is no active tab or there is no previous history entry to go back to. It may also refuse if the current page is no longer in a navigable state (for example, the session has ended).

tool_schemas.name: browser_network_requests
tool_schemas.description: Returns the network requests observed for the active tab since the current page load began. It refuses the request when there is no active tab or no page has been loaded in the current tab yet, because there is no request log to report against. It may also refuse when network tracking is not available for the session.

tool_schemas.name: browser_take_screenshot
tool_schemas.description: Captures an image of the current page and returns the captured screenshot result, either for the visible viewport, the full scrollable page, or a specific element. It refuses requests that specify only one of element/ref (both must be provided together for an element screenshot), and refuses requests that set fullPage together with an element screenshot because those modes conflict. It also refuses when the requested image type is not one of the supported formats or when there is no active page to capture.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to screenshot the element. If not provided, the screenshot will be taken of viewport. If element is provided, ref must be provided too.

filename.description: File name to save the screenshot to. Defaults to `page-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg}` if not specified. Prefer relative file names to stay within the output directory.

fullPage.description: When true, takes a screenshot of the full scrollable page, instead of the currently visible viewport. Cannot be used with element screenshots.

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot. If not provided, the screenshot will be taken of viewport. If ref is provided, element must be provided too.

type.description: Image format for the screenshot. Default is png.

tool_schemas.name: browser_snapshot
tool_schemas.description: Captures and returns an accessibility-focused snapshot of the current page state, optionally including console messages and/or network requests. It refuses the request when there is no active tab or no page is available to snapshot. It also refuses unknown fields in the request body because the snapshot options are strictly limited to the supported flags.

includeConsole.description: Whether to include console messages in the captured page state snapshot.

includeNetwork.description: Whether to include network requests in the captured page state snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: browser_click
tool_schemas.description: Clicks a specific page element identified by its snapshot reference and returns the resulting updated state after the interaction. It refuses the request when element/ref are missing, when the ref does not exist in the current snapshot, or when the element is not currently actionable (for example, detached, hidden, or disabled). It also refuses unsupported button values or modifier combinations that cannot be applied in the current environment.

button.description: Button to click, defaults to left

doubleClick.description: Whether to perform a double click instead of a single click

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

tool_schemas.name: browser_drag
tool_schemas.description: Performs a drag-and-drop from the start element to the end element (both identified by snapshot references) and returns the updated state after the interaction. It refuses the request when any of startElement/startRef/endElement/endRef are missing, when either ref is not present in the current snapshot, or when either element cannot be interacted with at the time of the drag. It also refuses when the drag cannot be completed because the page changes or the elements become invalid during the operation.

endElement.description: Human-readable target element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

endRef.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

startElement.description: Human-readable source element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

startRef.description: Exact source element reference from the page snapshot

tool_schemas.name: browser_hover
tool_schemas.description: Moves the pointer over a specific page element identified by its snapshot reference and returns the updated state after the hover. It refuses the request when element/ref are missing or when the ref does not match an element in the current snapshot. It also refuses when the element cannot be hovered (for example, it is not visible or has been removed from the page).

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

tool_schemas.implementation:
def browser_hover(element, ref):
    return {"action": "hover", "element": element, "ref": ref, "result": "hovered"}

tool_schemas.name: browser_select_option
tool_schemas.description: Selects one or more option values for a specific select control identified by its snapshot reference and returns the updated state after the selection. It refuses the request when element/ref/values are missing, when values is empty, when the ref does not exist in the current snapshot, or when the target is not a selectable control. It also refuses when any provided value does not correspond to an available option for that control or when multiple values are provided for a single-select element.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

values.description: Array of values to select in the dropdown. This can be a single value or multiple values.

tool_schemas.name: browser_tabs
tool_schemas.description: Lists tabs, creates a new tab, closes a tab, or selects an existing tab, and returns the resulting tab state after the action. It refuses requests with an unsupported action, and refuses close/select when the provided index does not refer to an existing tab (or when there is no current tab to close if index is omitted). It may also refuse to close the last remaining tab when the session requires at least one tab to stay open.

index.description: Tab index, used for close/select. If omitted for close, current tab is closed.

tool_schemas.name: browser_wait_for
tool_schemas.description: Waits until the provided text appears, the provided textGone disappears, or the specified time elapses, and then returns the updated state when the wait condition is satisfied. It refuses the request when none of text, textGone, or time is provided because there is no wait condition to evaluate. It also refuses when time is negative or when both text and textGone are provided in a way that cannot be evaluated against the current page (for example, no active page to observe).

textGone.description: The text to wait for to disappear

time.description: The time to wait in seconds

metadata.name: Voyager Session Vault
metadata.description: Captures, snapshots, and automates live browser sessions—persisting page state, network activity, console output, and user interactions for later inspection and replay.
